photos.desc: What are these tracks, and who cut down these trees? If you guessed "Beaver" then you are correct! The Apache-Sitgreaves National Forests is home to Beavers and lots of wildlife.
Photo personnelle: un castor aux aguets sur le chemin Rivière-aux-Rats, près de Manawan .
